source.note: Recorded from a clean checkout of the commit named in head (git status was empty when it was written); ordinary Normal gen-2 (arrivals on) at tick 48000 (day 20), rules 280, saved and continued 120 ticks. One pin for rules 280 alone, bedtime (src/sim/bedtime.ts: after dark a child under eight is offered sleep whether tired or not and sleeps till the morning light, and takes up only bed, rest and bodily needs, and nobody starts a talk with one). It is the same world, tick and continuation length as the rules 278 and 279 pins, written with a copy of their helper (tests/helpers/v280ref.ts), so the pins can be compared digest by digest. Rules 280 adds no saved field, no draw and no feed line; the counts beside the digests are the same kind as the 279 pin's and are of the saved world.
